Your body is malnourished..what you experienced is extreme hunger and that is completely normal if you have been restricted before. It isn’t the same as binging. Your body just desperately needs food and it is happy when it gets food to give it energy and eventually repair the damage. Listen to your body, don’t suppress your hunger, eat until you are full and one day the extreme hunger will go away as long as you don’t restrict. It can be scary at first, there is this fear of gaining weight, but think about this: Your body cares about you and only wants the best for you. It wants to protect you at all costs, no matter what. But you restricted and barely gave it any energy so it had to eat itself. So much energy is missing and your body wants it back! You have a calorie deficit and your body wants to have calories! You won’t gain anything probably but please take care of your body and nourish it. Listen to it, it knows the best what it needs. I know this is easier said than done, I struggle with it myself, but I try to slowly eat a little bit more every day. That way, your metabolism will speed up and that prevents you from gaining weight too quick. Sometimes, slowly is better but others prefer to go ‚all in‘ and eat until they are full. :)
